history_summary.value: The Polbar was created between 1946 and 1954 by Laura Kaufman, who crossed the Polish Green-legged Partridge with the American Plymouth Rock to give chicks a sex-linked eye-stripe so they could be sexed at hatch. It now survives only as a single conservation flock at a Polish agricultural research station.
